_meta.description: Payment packages, pricing tiers, payment methods, and related game data extracted from decompiled Sim Companies JS
_meta.source: decompiled/modules/chunk_X4i.js, chunk_K3i.js, chunk_OPi.js, chunk_smi.js, chunk_Mor_2.js, chunk_hae.js, chunk_kzt.js, entry.js
_meta.critical_note: Package SKUs, specific prices, and simboost quantities are SERVER-DRIVEN via /api/v4/payment-packages/{type}/. The client JS contains only the rendering logic and data model. No hardcoded package definitions exist in the frontend code.

fields.simBoosts: number - base amount of simboosts in this package
fields.starting: boolean - true if this is a starter pack (1-time purchase)
fields.isSupporter: boolean - true if this grants supporter status
fields.supporter: boolean - true if this IS a supporter package
fields.supporterOnly: boolean - true if only visible to supporters
fields.hq: number|null - HQ skin index from hqUnlockables array (for HQ skin packages)
fields.wideFrame: boolean - true for wider card layout
fields.limit: number|undefined - max purchases per player (undefined = unlimited)
fields.googleSku: string - Google Play SKU for Android in-app purchases
fields.appleSku: string - Apple App Store SKU for iOS in-app purchases
fields.steamSku: string - Steam itemdefid for Steam purchases
fields.approximateCurrency: object - approximate local currency values for display
fields.ignore: boolean - if true, purchase bypasses normal flow (used for free packages)

hqSkinUnlockables._note: HQ skins purchasable with simboosts. simboosts=null means seasonal/event-only (not purchasable directly). simboosts=0 means default/free.

methods.name: Stripe (Credit/Debit Card)
methods.notes: Default payment provider for web (per changelog: 'Make Stripe default payment provider for web')

methods.name: Braintree / PayPal
methods.notes: Supports PayPal, credit cards, Venmo via Braintree SDK. 'PayPal payments suffered from integration issue on PayPal's end, during the weekend 9th March and 10th March. The issue has now been resolved'

methods.name: Apple Pay (In-App Purchase)
methods.notes: Uses Apple StoreKit. Processes pending transactions on mount. Supports receipt refresh.

methods.name: Google Pay (In-App Purchase)
methods.notes: Uses Google Play Billing. Consumes tokens after successful server validation. 'Google simboost purchases fixes - stability improvements and no-refresh after purchase implemented'

methods.name: Steam Wallet
methods.notes: Uses Steamworks SDK. Registers onOrderFinished and onOrderFailed callbacks. 'Integrated payment support with the Steam platform.' 'Fix simboost purchase sale not being reflected for Steam users'

methods.name: TRON (Crypto - TRX/USDT)
components: sTi (TRON payment UI with QR codes)
methods.notes: Supports both TRX and USDT (TRC-20). Shows deposit address + QR code. Polls for payment confirmation. Minimum USDT threshold: 15 USDT for large QR display. 'Added TRX/USDT (TRON) payment option'

methods.name: Algorand (ALGO)
methods.notes: REMOVED per changelog: 'Remove Algorand integration, NFT trading, and collectible auction house'. Was active until ~2024. 'ALGO simboosts pricing reduced by about 10% - to reflect no payment provider fees when this method is used'

baseSimBoosts.description: Total simboosts awarded = base simBoosts from package + bonuses
baseSimBoosts.calculation: package.simBoosts + floor(countryBonus% * package.simBoosts / 100) + floor(playerBonus% * package.simBoosts / 100) + floor(salePromotion% * total / 100)
baseSimBoosts.notes: Country bonus applied only if countryCodeIso is set. Player bonus applied if bonus > 0. Sale promotion applied on top of the already-bonused total.

supporterDiscount.message: All prices listed already reflect your 10% supporter discount. Thank you for your support.

response_fields.bonus: number - percentage bonus simboosts for this country

countryPricing.notes: Changelog mentions displaying BRL/CZK/IDR/TRY value estimates on checkout

response_fields.validUntil: string - ISO date when bonus expires

playerBonuses.message: You will get {bonus}% more simboosts with your next purchase. Offer expires in {countdown}.

fields.promotionPercentage: number - extra percentage on top of all other bonuses
fields.simboostsWithHQ: array of { hqIdx: number, simboosts: number } - extra SB for specific HQ packages

displayLabels.bestValue: Shown on: starter packs (if not yet purchased), or package with highest simBoosts count
displayLabels.mostPopular: Shown on: package with exactly 300 simBoosts (and starting pack already purchased)
displayLabels.purchaseLimit: Shown when package.limit is set: 'Purchase is limited to {limit} packs per player'
displayLabels.supporter: Labeled 'Supporter' with badge and discount info
displayLabels.supporterPackMessage: All simboosts unlocks except for HQ skins

filtering.supporterOnly: Packages with supporterOnly=true only shown to existing supporters
filtering.startingPack: Starting packs hidden if already purchased (startingPackPurchased=true)
filtering.isSupporter: Supporter packages hidden if already purchased (supporterPurchased=true)
filtering.priceFilter: When simboostsSalePromotion is active with HQ packages, filter out packages priced >= $60 (unless they match an HQ in the promotion)

simBoostUsageCosts.hqSkins: See hqSkinUnlockables above (0-300 simboosts per skin)

exchangeLimit.mechanism: Phase-based daily exchange limit (simboosts to cash)
exchangeLimit.changelogRef: Simboosts exchange for money limited by realm phase. (1st phase: 2,000/day; 2nd phase 4,000/day; 3rd phase 6,000/day, ... 10,000/day max)

simBoostUsageCosts.buildingRush: Variable simboost cost to rush construction
simBoostUsageCosts.restaurantTrigger: +5 simboosts to produce or sell daily
simBoostUsageCosts.collectiblesExchange: Players trade collectible items for simboosts (90-day purchase period)

campaigns.description: Turkey-Syria earthquake response fundraiser. 20% extra simboosts on all purchases during this period.

checkoutFlow._source: chunk_X4i.js (_Oi, hOi, fvt, sTi, aOi), chunk_OPi.js (f3i, v3i)

routes./checkout/package/:sku: Single package checkout page (fvt component) - web payments
routes./checkout/options/:sku: Alternative payment options page (fvt + _Ti) - shows platform choices

web_stripe: 4. User fills payment details and submits
6. Server syncs Stripe session -> awards simboosts
7. Animated simboost count flies to HUD counter
web_braintree: 3. User selects payment method (card, PayPal, Venmo) and submits
5. On success: finishPayment() -> animated simboost count
web_tron: 4. User sends TRX/USDT to deposit address
5. User clicks 'I have sent the payment'
7. QR code shown for amounts >= 15 USDT
ios: 1. App requests Apple products via StoreKit
4. Receipt sent to server for validation
5. On success: simboosts awarded, StoreKit transaction finished
android: 1. App fetches available Google Play SKUs
5. On success: token consumed, simboosts awarded
steam: 1. Steam overlay opens with product listing

keyFiles.chunk_X4i.js: Main checkout page component (_Oi), package list (hOi), individual package checkout (fvt), TRON payment (sTi), Stripe callback (aOi), platform selection (_Ti)
keyFiles.chunk_OPi.js: Package card rendering (I1e), package grid (f3i), Braintree checkout (v3i), fundraising banners
keyFiles.chunk_K3i.js: Stripe API calls (K3i, X3i, Q3i, h4i), TRON invoice API calls (R4i, N4i), loading/success UI (M4i, rGt)
keyFiles.chunk_kzt.js: Buy button component (kzt), HQ unlock button (hht)
keyFiles.chunk_smi.js: API call functions: Azt (packages), Hmi (player bonuses), Vmi (country pricing), zmi (Apple purchase v1), Gmi (Apple purchase v2)
keyFiles.chunk_hae.js: Braintree SDK bundled code + i18n message constants
